mapper.sql: r.id, r.user_id, u.name AS member_name, u.team_id, t.name AS team_name, r.work_date, r.out_time, r.end_time, r.place, r.reason, r.status, r.current_approval_step, r.decided_by, r.rejected_reason, r.attendance_applied, r.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outside_work_requests(user_id, work_date, out_time, end_time, place, reason, status, current_approval_step) VALUES(#{userId}, #{workDate}, #{outTime}, #{endTime}, #{place}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{currentApprovalStep})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM outside_work_requests r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM outside_work_requests r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.work_date = #{workDate} AND r.status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED') LIMIT 1
